directive: 通知の発生状況と話者を踏まえ、必要な情報を簡潔に伝える。変数を保つ。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: I don't know any precise details! Go look for yourself, you should be able to hear the shots. Anyway, what is the point if the Bar has already been attacked? Come on man, I have helped you, now it's your turn to pay back.
entries.JA_current: I don't know any precise details! Go look for yourself, you should be able to hear the shots. Anyway, what is the point if the Bar has already been attacked? Come on man, I have helped you, now it's your turn to pay back.
entries.JA_new: 詳しいことは知らない！　自分で見に行け。銃声が聞こえるはずだ。そもそも、バーが襲われた後にどうするつもりだ？　なあ、こっちは助けてやったんだ。今度はお前が返す番だ。

entries.EN: Like hell you'll get the medkit! I ain't helping any of you Freedom morons!
entries.JA_current: Like hell you'll get the medkit! I ain't helping any of you Freedom morons!
entries.JA_new: 救急キットなんか渡すか！　フリーダムの馬鹿どもを助ける気はない！

entries.EN: Sorry, bro, but I'm all out of meds. Not enough for myself even.
entries.JA_current: Sorry, bro, but I'm all out of meds. Not enough for myself even.
entries.JA_new: 悪いな、兄弟。薬は全部使い切った。自分の分すら足りない。

entries.EN: Here, take it. I'm not about to leave you to the mutants...
entries.JA_current: Here, take it. I'm not about to leave you to the mutants...
entries.JA_new: ほら、持ってけ。ミュータントに食われるのを見過ごすわけにはいかない……

entries.EN: By the way, how did you survive this long out here? The village is swarming with bloodsuckers.
entries.JA_current: By the way, how did you survive this long out here? The village is swarming with bloodsuckers.
entries.JA_new: ところで、よく今まで生き延びたな？　村はブラッドサッカーだらけだぞ。

entries.EN: Maybe we just missed each other.
entries.JA_current: Maybe we just missed each other.
entries.JA_new: たまたますれ違っただけかもな。

entries.EN: You lucky bastard!
entries.JA_current: You lucky bastard!
entries.JA_new: 運のいい野郎だ！

entries.EN: I sure am.
entries.JA_current: I sure am.
entries.JA_new: まったくだ。

entries.EN: What d'ya want, stalker?
entries.JA_current: What d'ya want, stalker?
entries.JA_new: 何の用だ、ストーカー？

entries.EN: What are you doing, guys?
entries.JA_current: What are you doing, guys?
entries.JA_new: お前ら、何してる？

entries.EN: What's it to you?
entries.JA_current: What's it to you?
entries.JA_new: お前には関係ないだろ？

entries.EN: Damn, you're a mean mutt, aren't you!?
entries.JA_current: Damn, you're a mean mutt, aren't you!?
entries.JA_new: くそっ、ずいぶん凶暴な犬だな？！

entries.EN: Piss off and make it fast, before I introduce you to my little hollow-point friends over here!
entries.JA_current: Piss off and make it fast, before I introduce you to my little hollow-point friends over here!
entries.JA_new: 失せろ。さっさと消えないと、こいつらホローポイント弾を食らわせるぞ！

entries.EN: Sure, those still ought to be bigger than your shriveled excuse of a dick, right?
entries.JA_current: Sure, those still ought to be bigger than your shriveled excuse of a dick, right?
entries.JA_new: それでも、お前のしなびた粗末なモノよりは大きいんだろ？

entries.EN: Shut the fuck up! Come on, guys, lets waste the motherfucker - he's getting on my nerves...
entries.JA_current: Shut the fuck up! Come on, guys, lets waste the motherfucker - he's getting on my nerves...
entries.JA_new: 黙りやがれ！　おい、お前ら、こいつを始末しろ。いい加減、頭にきた……

entries.EN: Ah shit..
entries.JA_current: Ah shit..
entries.JA_new: ああ、くそ……

entries.EN: Hi!
entries.JA_current: Hi!
entries.JA_new: よう！

entries.EN: Greetings. Are you "Outrage"?
entries.JA_current: Greetings. Are you "Outrage"?
entries.JA_new: こんにちは。あなたが「アウトレイジ」ですか？

entries.EN: Me? No, I'm pretty calm actually, He-he... That was a joke, pal. How can I help?
entries.JA_current: Me? No, I'm pretty calm actually, He-he... That was a joke, pal. How can I help?
entries.JA_new: 俺が？　いや、どっちかといえば冷静なほうだよ。へへ……冗談さ、相棒。何の用だ？

entries.EN: I need the container from the X-16 lab.
entries.JA_current: I need the container from the X-16 lab.
entries.JA_new: X-16研究所のケースが必要だ。

entries.EN: Oh yeah? Well, when you find it, let me know because I need it too, dude.
entries.JA_current: Oh yeah? Well, when you find it, let me know because I need it too, dude.
entries.JA_new: そうか？　見つけたら教えてくれよ。俺も必要なんだ。

entries.EN: Don't bullshit me! I know you have it.
entries.JA_current: Don't bullshit me! I know you have it.
entries.JA_new: でたらめを言うな！　お前が持ってるのは分かってる。

entries.EN: Wow, it's been a long time since someone spoke to me like that... Do you even understand just who you're talking to right now, bitchie?
entries.JA_current: Wow, it's been a long time since someone spoke to me like that... Do you even understand just who you're talking to right now, bitchie?
entries.JA_new: へえ、そんな口をきく奴は久しぶりだ……お前、自分が誰と話してるか分かってんのか、このクソ女？

entries.EN: I do, and I'm choosing my words carefully. I'd advise you to do the same. Look, I wouldn't be over here wasting time with you if this wasn't important!
entries.JA_current: I do, and I'm choosing my words carefully. I'd advise you to do the same. Look, I wouldn't be over here wasting time with you if this wasn't important!
entries.JA_new: 分かっていますし、言葉も選んでいます。あなたもそうしたほうがいい。大事な用件でなければ、わざわざここまで来ません。

entries.EN: Too bad, man, I don't give a shit about you or your "important" matters. Go to hell, ask uncle Lucifer to help you out! Just quit wasting my time.
entries.JA_current: Too bad, man, I don't give a shit about you or your "important" matters. Go to hell, ask uncle Lucifer to help you out! Just quit wasting my time.
entries.JA_new: 残念だったな。お前にも、その「大事な用件」にも興味はない。地獄へ行って、叔父のルシファーに助けてもらえ！　俺の時間を無駄にするな。

entries.EN: Hey, "Outrage"...
entries.JA_current: Hey, "Outrage"...
entries.JA_new: なあ、「アウトレイジ」……

entries.EN: I thought I told ya to go to hell... What, you want me to arrange an express one way ticket downstairs for you? Afraid to go hang yourself? Get lost before I incinerate you...
entries.JA_current: I thought I told ya to go to hell... What, you want me to arrange an express one way ticket downstairs for you? Afraid to go hang yourself? Get lost before I incinerate you...
entries.JA_new: 地獄へ行けと言ったはずだが……何だ、片道切符でも手配してほしいのか？　首を吊るのが怖いか？　失せろ。さもないと焼き殺すぞ……

entries.EN: I'm not going anywhere without that container.
entries.JA_current: I'm not going anywhere without that container.
entries.JA_new: ケースを渡すまで、帰らない。

entries.EN: Oh yeah!? How about I give you the barrel of my gun instead, will you go away when I shove that in your mouth and blow your stupid birdbrain into pink mist?? Fuck it, you were asking for it, draw your weapon! Let's go!
entries.JA_current: Oh yeah!? How about I give you the barrel of my gun instead, will you go away when I shove that in your mouth and blow your stupid birdbrain into pink mist?? Fuck it, you were asking for it, draw your weapon! Let's go!
entries.JA_new: そうか？！　なら銃口をくわえさせてやる。口の中で撃ち抜いて、その間抜けな鳥頭をピンク色の霧にしてやろうか？！　くそっ、そこまで言うなら武器を抜け！　やってやる！

entries.EN: As you wish, hotshot.
entries.JA_current: As you wish, hotshot.
entries.JA_new: お望みどおりに、威勢のいい奴だな。

entries.EN: Don't have much of a choice. I'm a dead man walking either way.
entries.JA_current: Don't have much of a choice. I'm a dead man walking either way.
entries.JA_new: 他に選択肢はない。どうせ俺はもう死んだも同然だ。
